SELECT T3.Name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.concert_ID = T2.concert_ID JOIN singer AS T3 ON T2.Singer_ID = T3.Singer_ID WHERE T1.Year = '2014'
SELECT s.Name, s.Location FROM stadium s JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID WHERE c.Year IN ('2014', '2015') GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID;
SELECT MIN(T2.weight) FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.StuID = T2.StuID WHERE T1.Fname = 'Youngest' AND T1.LName = 'Dog';

SELECT T2.PetType, MAX(T2.weight)
FROM Students AS T1
JOIN Has_Pet AS T3 ON T1.StuID = T3.StuID
JOIN Pets AS T2 ON T3.PetID = T2.PetID
GROUP BY T2.PetType;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.StuID) FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.StuID = T2.StuID WHERE T1.Age > 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Pets AS T1 JOIN Student AS T2 ON T1.PetID = T2.StuID WHERE T2.Sex = 'F' AND T1.pet_type = 'Dog';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.PetType) FROM Pets AS T1
SELECT T1.PetID, T1.weight FROM Pets AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.PetID = T2.PetID WHERE T2.Age > 1;
SELECT T1.PetType, AVG(T1.Age) AS Average_Age, MAX(T1.Age) AS Maximum_Age FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.StuID = T2.StuID JOIN Pets AS T3 ON T2.PetID = T3.PetID GROUP BY T1.PetType
